emily: Heads-up 90min call with EmberHealth earlier. ACH pull failed for INV-2028-201 ($42,500) and they're asking to set up a 3-month installment plan due to a temporary treasury hold.
billing-bot: [auto] payment attempt failed for INV-2028-201 amount $42500. reason=ACH_RETURNED code=R03
rory: Can we offer 3 installments: 14,167 / 14,167 / 14,166, with a one-time $500 plan fee? We'll mark invoice as payment-plan and schedule retries via our hosted payments.
emily: Customer (acct EH-993) asked for no service interruption while they sort treasury. They agreed to e-sign a terms addendum.
lucas: For payment plans > $25k we need a recorded approval + copy of signed addendum. I can approve the plan fee and the structure if legal signs off on the addendum. Approving conditionally: "Approved pending signed addendum uploaded to Zendesk ticket." :white_check_mark:
tess: I'll draft a one-page addendum template and attach to ZD #46021. Include fields: schedule, amounts, early-payment option, and ACH mandate.
grace: Quick ops note: When creating the plan, set invoice status=payment_plan and create three child scheduled charges so autopay runs on the 5th of each month. Also add a collection hold to avoid escalation while plan is active.
emily: I'll send the addendum and ping the customer to sign today. If they sign, please proceed to schedule. ETA 24h.
rory: Commands to schedule (internal):
```
POST /internal/finance/payment_plans { "invoice": "INV-2028-201", "schedule": ["2026-04-05","2026-05-05","2026-06-05"], "amounts": [14167,14167,14166], "fee": 500 }
POST /internal/finance/charges/schedule { "plan_id": "PP-2028-33" }
```
emily: Addendum signed and uploaded to ZD #46021. Customer confirms ACH on file.
lucas: Verified addendum in ticket. Approving plan and fee. Approved_by=lucas timestamp=1837003000 :white_check_mark:
rory: Scheduling plan now and creating collection task COL-2028-17. Setting collection hold=true.
rory: billing-bot shows first scheduled charge executed.
billing-bot: [auto] scheduled charge executed for PP-2028-33 installment=1 amount=$14167 payment_id=PAY-445566 settled_ts=1837004321 note="installment 1 of 3"
emily: Great, customer notified and services remain active. I'll close the Zendesk loop and add a note to the account. Thanks team. :pray:
